name: Azure AI Content Safety
short: Azure service detecting harmful content, prompt injection (Prompt Shields), jailbreaks, and groundedness in LLM inputs/outputs; text and image analysis with a free F0 tier.

plans.name: Free (F0)
plans.notes: 5,000 transactions per month free; prompt-injection detection, harmful-content categories, groundedness, and jailbreak detection; usage stops when the free limit is reached (no overage accrual); text records are billed in units of up to 1,000 Unicode code points.

plans.name: Standard (S0)
plans.notes: Higher throughput and enterprise features; per-1,000 text records and per-1,000 images beyond the free tier; supports Analyze Text and Analyze Image APIs.
